subject: Credential escrow & deploy safelist: evidence and sample artefacts
messages:
From: Claire Dunne <claire.dunne@northbridge.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security-assessor@northbridge.com
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Credential escrow & deploy safelist: initial scope questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intake earlier this week. As we scope the Secure SDLC evidence for the SIG assessment, a couple of targeted asks to help us size the collection and identify sample artefacts: 

1) Credential escrow / key custody – can you confirm whether customer-facing production keys are managed in a central KMS with documented rotation windows, and whether you have a short summary of rotation cadence and last rotation dates? A redacted rotation summary would be fine.

2) Deploy safelist / allowlist – for production deploys, do you have a configured safelist (e.g., approved image digests or CIDRs) enforced by the CD system? If so: a) small snippet of the pipeline config that shows enforcement, and b) an example of the safelist change approval record.

3) Provenance: sample signed commit or merge evidence showing an author + provenance chain (git log + signature) for a production release.

If you can provide the three items above (redacted is OK) and an estimated delivery by EOD Tuesday 16 March, we can include them in the assessor docket. Attachments can be Drive links or PDFs.

One quick note — we do not need your entire CI logs, just representative excerpts and the corresponding approval metadata.

Best,
Claire
Claire Dunne, Senior Assessor
Northbridge Assessments
(attachment: assessment-request-checklist.pdf, PDF)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Claire Dunne <claire.dunne@northbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credential escrow & deploy safelist: initial scope questions

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. High level answers and what we'll attach: 

1) Credential escrow / key custody
- Production keys are stored in a central KMS (customer key rings for customer-dedicated tenants; service keys in our Redwood-managed key ring). We rotate service keys on a 90-day cadence; customer-managed keys follow the customer KMS policy.
- Attaching a redacted rotation summary (kms-key-rotation-summary.pdf) showing last two rotations for the service key family and the rotation-owner ticket IDs.

2) Deploy safelist enforcement
- Our CD pipeline enforces image digest allowlist and a minimal CIDR egress allowlist. Enforcement is a pipeline task that checks a safelist artifact in an internal config repo and blocks deployment if mismatched.
- We'll include cd-pipeline-safelist-snippet.yaml (sanitized) plus the approval record stub (change ticket id RB-4218).

3) Provenance / signed commit
- We use GPG commit signing for release branches and require an approver signature via our merge bot for canary/production merges. Attached signed-commit-example.patch (redacted) demonstrates the git tag, signature block, and merge ticket.

Attachments are included and I've shared a read-only Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cKD-deploy-audit 

If you need the actual pipeline run (sanitized) rather than the snippet, say the word and Jordan can pull a time-bounded export.

Thanks — aiming to get these to you before EOD Tuesday.

—Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachment: kms-key-rotation-summary.pdf, PDF)
(attachment: cd-pipeline-safelist-snippet.yaml, YAML)
(attachment: signed-commit-example.patch, PATCH)

From: Claire Dunne <claire.dunne@northbridge.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security-assessor@northbridge.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credential escrow & deploy safelist: initial scope questions

Kimberly —

That looks perfect, thank you. Two clarifications before we finalize: 

• For the KMS summary — could you include the key rotation owner ticket links or IDs in the redacted PDF (we only need the ticket IDs to correlate timelines)? You mentioned rotation-owner ticket IDs — if they are in the file already, great.

• For the safelist change approval, we see RB-4218 referenced — can you include a short threaded excerpt (email or ticket comment) that shows the approver and timestamp? A single-line comment and timestamp is enough; redact the approver's internal email if needed.

If all good we'll slot the artifacts into the SIG matrix and flag a small follow-up if we need the full pipeline run.

Regards,
Claire
(attachment: evidence-scope-confirmation.txt)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Claire Dunne <claire.dunne@northbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credential escrow & deploy safelist: initial scope questions

Claire — attaching the small excerpts you requested. Notes below each file.

1) kms-key-rotation-summary.pdf (redacted) — includes rotation owner ticket IDs: TKT-9821, TKT-10117. We removed internal-only comments and left rotation dates and responsible role.

2) cd-pipeline-safelist-snippet.yaml — includes a pipeline step "verify_allowlist" and a reference to config repo path ops/configs/safelist/prod.json.

3) safelist-approval-excerpt.txt (inline excerpt):
- RB-4218 change request opened 2027-02-18 13:02 UTC
- Approval comment: "approved for rollout to prod at 2027-02-19T09:44Z — Marissa C."

4) signed-commit-example.patch — shows commit header, GPG signature header (ASCII-armored), and the release tag. We removed full diffs; this is a provenance sample only.

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cKD-deploy-audit

If you want the pipeline run extract (timeboxed to 2027-02-19) Jordan can provide a scrubbed JSON export; otherwise this should satisfy the assessor matrix.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
